Messages.Author: Vincent
Messages.Body:
Hi,

Can Mata Hari play Sacrifice to burn a non-Ravnos vampire controlled
by my prey?

Name: Mata Hari
[KMW:U/PAn]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Ravnos
Group: 4
Capacity: 7
Discipline: aus for qui CHI OBF
Independent. Red List: Mata Hari has 2 votes (titled). You and she may
play cards that require a sect and/or clan as if she were of that
required sect and/or clan.
Artist: Steve Prescott

Name: Sacrifice
[Sabbat:U, Tenth:B]
Cardtype: Political Action
{Requires a} Sabbat vampire with capacity above 7.
Choose a vampire with a capacity below 7 who belongs to the same clan
as the acting vampire. Successful referendum means the chosen vampire
is burned.
Artist: Clint Langley

Messages.Author: Abdul alHazred
Messages.Body:


- No, Sacrifice doesnt require a sect or clan requirements card that
Mata Hari plays have she is still Ravnos (unless you have built a good
deck that contains clan impersonation)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. She may play Sacrifice (using her ability to meet the
"Sabbat" requirements), but you'll have to choose a vampire with
capacity below seven who belongs to the same clan, and she's playing
Sacrifice as the Ravnos she is, since her ability doesn't allow her to
fake other clans at whim -- only when meeting clan requirements of
cards (and Sacrifice has no clan requirements, just a sect
requirement).
